renderOptions.title: Production settings

renderOptions.impact: Review and repairs take longer and cost more.
renderOptions.scope: Applies to agent replies, copy, on-screen text, captions and voice in this production.

gallery_wishes.title: Three Wishes in a Gallery
gallery_wishes.body: A 38-second vertical ad. Adapt the gallery, three wishes, and final twist to your product and story.
gallery_wishes.materialRequired: Go back to Materials and choose one clear product photo.
gallery_wishes.copyHelp: Describe actions, story changes, and any dialogue to speak verbatim. Use promotion settings for the offer and tagline.
gallery_wishes.copyPlaceholder: For example, the neighboring portrait leans out when the genie announces the price.

product_story.title: Cinematic product story
product_story.body: Recreate the 53-second headphone commercial with your product, following its 28 shots, three gesture transitions and final street dance.
product_story.referenceHelp: You can describe how the product is used, who it is for, or any exact dialogue. The assistant adapts the two spoken lines and cuts the film to the reference’s funk rhythm.
product_story.referencePlaceholder: For example, show an athlete using it between drills.
product_story.productNameHint: Enter the name of the product in your photo or video
product_story.materialRequired: Go back to Materials and add a clear product photo or clip.

shortcut_story.title: Already There
shortcut_story.body: Two ways to reach the same goal. Show how your product makes the easier way possible.

silk_road.title: Flavors of the Silk Road
silk_road.body: A 62-second widescreen film. Keep the sample’s camera moves and transitions while adapting the cast, locations and story to your materials.

soda_story.title: Soda commercial sample
soda_story.body: Use the sample’s pacing, lighting contrast, and product reveal. Recreate the ad for your shop, product, and copy.

wan_story.body: Use the sample’s pacing. The Agent writes a story from your product and copy, then chooses edits and reshoots from the footage.
